notify.agent_ready_body: Start a session to give it a task. It asks you to sign in the first time.
notify.health_delivery_failed: macOS couldn't deliver an alert. Your notifications are available in the inbox.
notify.health_denied: Mac alerts are disabled. Enable Diri in System Settings → Notifications.
notify.health_denied_inbox: Mac alerts are disabled. Enable Diri in System Settings → Notifications. Your inbox still works.
notify.health_enabled: Mac alerts are enabled. Focus mode and System Settings can silence delivery.
notify.health_initial: Use Test alert to check system notification delivery.
notify.health_not_determined: Use Test alert to enable Mac alerts. Your inbox already works.
notify.health_other_platform: System alerts are available on macOS and Windows. Your inbox works here.
notify.health_unpackaged: Mac alerts require the packaged Diri app. Your inbox still works.
